units.source_text: 是时宫中正在议立皇后。

en.t: At that time, the court was discussing the appointment of an empress.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣推荐梅壶女御，因为藤壶母后曾有遗言叫她照顾皇上。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, recommended the Umetsubo Consort, because Empress Mother Fujitsubo had left word that she should take care of the Emperor.

units.source_text: 但世人认为藤壶与梅壶都是亲王家的女儿，

en.t: But people thought that both Fujitsubo and Umetsubo were daughters of princely houses,

units.source_text: 两代皇后不宜都出自亲王家，因此未能赞同。

en.t: and that it was improper for empresses of two successive reigns both to come from princely families, so they could not agree.

units.source_text: 世人主张：“弘徽殿女御入宫最早，理应册立为后。”

en.t: People argued, "The Kokiden Consort entered the palace first, so she ought to be installed as empress."

units.source_text: 于是两方的袒护人暗中竞争，各有操心。

en.t: Thus the supporters of the two sides competed in secret, each with their own concerns.

units.source_text: 此外还有兵部卿亲王其人，现已改任式部卿，

en.t: In addition, there was the prince formerly known as the Minister of War, who had now been transferred to the post of Minister of Ceremonial Affairs,

units.source_text: 为本朝国舅，深得皇上信赖。

en.t: and as the Emperor's maternal relative, he was deeply trusted by His Majesty.

units.source_text: 他的女儿早已入宫，和梅壶一样当了女御。

en.t: His daughter had entered the palace long before and, like Umetsubo, had become a consort.

units.source_text: 袒护他的人认为：“既然要立亲王家女儿为后，

en.t: Those who supported him argued, "If a daughter of a princely house is to be made empress,

units.source_text: 则式部卿家的女儿与梅壶同等，且是藤壶母后的侄女，较为亲近。

en.t: then the daughter of the Minister of Ceremonial Affairs is equal to Umetsubo, and she is also Empress Mother Fujitsubo's niece, making her the closer relation.

units.source_text: 母后逝世之后，由她来代替母后照顾皇上，最为适当。”

en.t: After the Empress Mother's death, it would be most fitting for her to take the Empress Mother's place in caring for the Emperor."

units.source_text: 三方各有理由，互相竞争。

en.t: All three sides had their reasons and competed with one another.

units.source_text: 但结果终于册立了梅壶女御为皇后，世称秋好皇后。

en.t: But in the end, the Umetsubo Consort was finally installed as empress, and she became known to the world as Empress Akikonomu.

units.source_text: 时人闻此消息，无不惊叹，

en.t: When people of the time heard this news, all of them were astonished and full of admiration,

units.source_text: 认为梅壶女御好大福分，和她母亲六条妃子完全相反。

en.t: thinking that the Umetsubo Consort was extraordinarily fortunate, the complete opposite of her mother, the Rokujo Lady.
